messages:
Ashwin: Quick sync — we need final owners + sign-offs for the new APAC edge region before Thursday deploy. Main open items: network peering contracts, routing policy PRs, KMS binding for residency keys, and DB replica residency confirmation. Can people call dibs?
Leah: I can take network peering contracts. Will ping legal for the SLA clauses today.
Sam: I'll own the routing policy PRs and the envoy/ingress changes. PR is up at https://git.company/repo/pull/482 — needs review from @Tyler.
Tyler: on it, will review in the next hour. Quick note: the ingress change touches the egress ACLs — might need security signoff. @Leah can you confirm network ACLs allow the peering CIDRs?
Leah: ACLs look fine, but legal wants a short note that peering is limited to infra control plane IPs. Adding that to the contract draft now.
Jia: I'll run the smoke tests after Sam merges. Planning to run the following from staging:```kubectl --context=apac-staging run curl --image=radial/curl --rm -it -- curl -sS https://edge.healthcheck/ping```If that passes I'll run db-residency checks next.
Marta: For KMS binding I can handle IAM roles and the key policy. Need the exact project IDs and the service account name that will be used by the runtime. @Ashwin can you confirm?
Ashwin: Service account will be infra-edge@redwood-prod. Project IDs: redwood-apac-edge-01 and redwood-apac-edge-02. Marta please add the allow-encrypt/decrypt for those SAs only.
Sam: FYI the routing PR includes a fallback route to the global model pool if the edge capacity is saturated — that behavior was requested by product. Flagging for ops that this will add cross-region egress.
Tyler: noted. Ops/finance: cross-region egress estimates? I can gate the PR behind a toggle if cost looks off.
Leah: Legal + security ok with clause. Added comment in contract draft: "peering restricted; audit logs retained 365d" :thumbsup:.
Jia: Smoke tests passed on staging edge; healthcheck ok, but one DB replica reporting zone mismatch. Running a quick query: ```SELECT zone, role FROM replicas WHERE region='apac'``` returns an unexpected us-west replica. Tagging @Marta and @Ashwin.
Marta: Looking — that replica is an old bootstrap copy. I'll promote the correct apac replica and demote the us-west copy, then verify TTL.
Oncall-Bot: Reminder scheduled: edge-deploy-checks at 2026-05-14T09:00Z (assigned: Sam, Jia, Tyler).
Ashwin: Thanks. Action items summary: Leah — finalize peering + legal note; Sam — merge routing PR and coordinate toggle; Tyler — review + hold toggle if egress > budget; Marta — KMS/IAM and fix replica; Jia — run final smoke + DB verify. If everyone hits these by EOD Wednesday we can proceed with Thursday deploy. Ping here with any blockers.
Tyler: Will update budget estimate by 1600 PT and ping here.
Sam: Merging after Tyler signoff.
Leah: Contract sent to legal for final sign-off.
Marta: Replica fixed and KMS policy applied in two projects. Verified encrypt/decrypt for infra-edge@redwood-prod only.
Jia: Final smoke tests green in staging and canary. No other replicas in wrong zones.
Ashwin: Perfect. Locking deploy window Thursday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thanks everyone :rocket:
